transportSteps: Enumerate runs and attempts with GitHub connector; fetch each run's artifacts. Reconcile missing observations.
Use github_download_workflow_artifact for a selected non-expired agk-measurement-review-/agk-measurement-outcome- artifact. Preserve id/run/attempt and expected size.
Use download_file with the returned Sediment file_id to obtain a local workspace ZIP. Do not publish or persist signed download URLs or shell-curl those URLs.

For measurement archives: limit compressed ZIP to 2 MiB, sum uncompressed entries to 8 MiB, entry count to 8, and reject absolute paths, parent traversal, duplicate names, symlinks and unexpected non-JSON entries before extraction. Limit each JSON to the production reader's 256 KiB/depth limits; overflow remains a collection gap.

Validate archive records using the pinned production measurement validator and normalize/redact only via the production allowlist. Include all phases of an attempt; do not replace unknowns with success.

Write only validated redacted measurement exports and public inventory into timestamped archive JSON on the evidence branch, then read back and compare. Stop on write/read/validation failure and report the gap.
